usedFor: Shopify lists the products and Linkila shortens the links, so “New Product” can feed “Create Short Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Short Link” in Linkila
bestTemplate.why: Each product gets a branded short link with an optional slug and title, ready to share.

watchOut: “Update Link” can change destinations and passwords of existing links, so point it only at links you mean to edit.
